title: Food and Shopping
summary: 点餐、购物、数量表达、价格和礼貌请求。
objectives: Order food and ask about portions

passages.transcript: Thanks for asking about the food tasting. It lasts 25 minutes. A ticket costs 8 pounds. We have space for 20 people. We’ll give you a map when you arrive.

vocabulary.example: Our lunch budget is twenty pounds.
Keep your receipt for a return.
Could we have the bill, please?

listening.title: Weekly Challenge: Eat and Shop
listening.transcript: The soup is six pounds and the sandwich is eight. We can share one dessert for four. Water is free, so we’ll spend eighteen pounds altogether.

passages.title: A phone reminder
passages.transcript: Hi, I’m calling from the market hall to confirm your booking. We’re holding the food tasting on Sunday. It starts at 12 fifteen. You can call back if you’d like to change your booking.

questions.q: On which day does the event take place?
What time does the event begin?

passages.title: At the front desk
passages.transcript: Welcome to the market hall! Are you here for the food tasting? Please meet us in the Garden Room. The session lasts 45 minutes. It begins at 12 fifteen. I can show you where to go.

passages.title: A ticket enquiry
passages.transcript: Thanks for asking about the food tasting. It lasts 45 minutes. A ticket costs 9 pounds. We have space for 16 people. We’ll give you a map when you arrive.

passages.title: A message from the organiser
passages.transcript: A quick note for everyone joining the food tasting at the market hall. There are 16 places. Use the west entrance. Please bring a pencil. If you need help, ask for Sofia. See you there!

questions.q: What are visitors asked to bring?

speaking.prompt: 你有 £20，口头为两人安排午餐，同时购买水瓶。说明取舍和总价。
speaking.sample: Two sandwiches and a bottle cost twenty pounds. Could we have two sandwiches, please?

practice.prompt: 用两句英语回答「Weekly Challenge: Eat and Shop」的场景。用到 budget，并给一个具体细节。
checklist: 与 Weekly Challenge: Eat and Shop 场景有关

practice.prompt: 你想参加 market hall 的 food tasting。向工作人员询问地点和开始时间。
你的同伴没听清刚才的活动通知。用自己的话复述日期、房间和费用。
同伴无法按时到达 food tasting。告诉对方你会怎么办，并询问对方是否同意。
checklist: 用问句确认对方是否同意

reading.title: 同时完成点餐和购物任务
reading.text: Market lunch set: rice bowl £9, soup £5, or sandwich £7. Add a drink for £2. A reusable bottle costs £6 at the stall next door. Card payments accepted.

passages.title: Online booking page
passages.text: Food tasting bookings close at 12:00. Reserve your place online before that time. Look for a confirmation in your email inbox.

questions.q: When is the online booking deadline?

passages.title: Ticket collection sign
passages.text: Ticket collection: show your confirmation at the market hall information desk. If you arrive late, wait by the entrance until a member of staff comes to meet you.

questions.q: Where do you collect your ticket?

passages.title: Payment instructions
passages.text: Pay by card when you book the food tasting. Keep the confirmation email until the event is over.

passages.title: Message for participants
passages.text: Plans changed? You can move your booking free of charge until Sunday. If you arrive late, please wait at the entrance until a member of staff comes to meet you.

writing.prompt: 写 75–95 词，记录菜品数量、购物决定、总价和一句礼貌请求。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（复习礼貌请求、数量和付款）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

practice.prompt: 给朋友写 2–3 句关于「Weekly Challenge: Eat and Shop」的英语消息，使用 budget 并补充一个具体细节。
写 25–40 词邀请朋友参加 food tasting，写明时间、房间和要带的物品。
写 25–40 词给将要迟到的朋友，根据阅读通知告诉对方到哪里等、向谁求助。
写 35–50 词说明你在「Weekly Challenge: Eat and Shop」场景中的选择与理由，尽量运用本课语法（复习礼貌请求、数量和付款）。

quiz.explanation: Could you tell me ...? 可礼貌询问信息。
options: Could you tell me the price?
quiz.answer: Could you tell me the price?
quiz.prompt: Which request is polite and asks for the price?
What does “budget” mean in this lesson?
